test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Here, in truth, lies / the crux of the / great problem of all.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "great problem of all."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"great problem of all"** should be **"greatest problem of all."**
 
• **Superlative adjectives** are used to compare three or more things and indicate
